comics.title: Alien Invasion, Part 1: Lights in the Sky
comics.blurb: Made at Logan's request. Aliens crash the cookout at Grandma Tina and Grandpa Duane's and beam away Nick's burgers. Logan finds a gadget they dropped, and it ends on a cliffhanger when the mothership takes Dad and Uncle Nick.

comics.title: Alien Invasion, Part 2: Logan Saves the Day
comics.blurb: Made at Logan's request. Logan uses the gadget to get the family aboard, Savannah pops the bubble cage with her hair clip, and Logan stands up to the five-eyed captain and earns a gold star badge. Everyone ends up back home at the cookout.

comics.title: The Snowy Thankful Jar
comics.blurb: On a snowy Thanksgiving, the Thankful Jar goes missing. Logan slows down, finds it, and learns that thanks comes before pie.

comics.title: Mom and the Great Outdoors
comics.blurb: The family goes camping. Mom is not a fan of tents. Logan notices what she needs, and they camp their own way under the stars.
